visual_brief.subject: OpenAI turned Linux vulnerability research into a pipeline
verified_context: OpenAI describes a staged prototype moving from candidate findings through dynamic reproduction and exploitability assessment to candidate patches and human review.
The reported counts and costs come from one controlled first-party campaign.
The story treats maintainer acceptance as a separate gate from patch generation.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Security value emerges as uncertain findings pass through progressively stronger evidence gates.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A sequence of tactile stone inspection chambers narrows rough fragments into a few precise pieces and one fitted repair insert.

candidate_notes.A: Selected: four illuminated stone chambers visibly reduce a pile of rough findings to a few candidates and finally a fitted terracotta repair. The sequence is legible in wide and thumbnail crops.
candidate_notes.B: Nested sieves suggest filtering, but the outdoor workshop setting and scattered debris weaken the controlled evidence-gate metaphor and compact legibility.
candidate_notes.C: Petal-shaped sorting basins communicate classification, but not a staged pipeline; the final repair is too ambiguous.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 21:9 center crop preserves the full four-stage reduction and fitted repair.
crop_review.article_mobile: All chambers remain readable in 16:9, including the rough input and repaired endpoint.
crop_review.square: The square crop emphasizes the middle evidence gates while retaining partial input and final repair context.
crop_review.thumbnail: At 320px wide, the decreasing fragment count and terracotta repair remain visible.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared all candidates above the declared references for architectural depth, pale-stone materiality, restrained warm accents and orderly multi-stage composition. A is closest to that language and uniquely communicates progressive evidence gates.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Codex model self-review of three full-size candidates, two declared golden references, a reference-first comparison sheet, and desktop/mobile/square/thumbnail crops. The canonical Playwright renderer could not launch because Chromium was unavailable, so ImageMagick produced the equivalent inspected sheet; repository validation remains authoritative.

A.prompt: Wide sequence of four tactile pale-stone inspection chambers reducing rough fragments into a few precise pieces and one fitted terracotta repair insert; no text or interface elements.

B.prompt: Wide tactile workshop of nested stone-and-metal sieves progressively sorting rough vulnerability fragments into a fitted repair piece; restrained editorial palette and no prohibited elements.

C.prompt: Wide sculptural set of connected pale-stone sorting basins reducing rough findings toward a central fitted terracotta repair; restrained tactile editorial materiality and no prohibited elements.
